meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 当编辑类工具(apply_patch、write、edit 等)成功执行后,插件会注册 PostToolUse 钩子;若 comment-checker 报出警告,Codex 会收到阻塞性反馈,需要先修复或解释被标记的注释才能继续。
howto.when: 在 Codex 用 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类工具成功执行之后触发;非编辑类工具会被忽略,不触发。

say.text: comment-checker 报的这条警告是什么意思?
say.note: Codex 会说明被标记的注释问题

say.text: 帮我把被标记的那条注释改掉再继续
say.note: Codex 先修复注释再往下走

say.text: 这条注释我不想改,说明一下原因

howto.what_en: After a successful edit-like tool call (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.), the plugin registers a PostToolUse hook. If comment-checker warns after a patch, Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before moving on.
howto.when_en: Triggered in Codex after edit-like tools (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) run successfully. Non-edit tools are ignored, so they do not trigger it.

say_en.text: What does this comment-checker warning mean?
Fix the flagged comment, then continue
say_en.note: Codex fixes it before going on

say_en.text: I don't want to change that comment; explain why it's flagged
